t: When you need something to hold on to
a: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۙ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
p: Wa nunazzilu mina-l-qur'āni mā huwa shifā'un wa raḥmatun li-l-mu'minīn…
m: And We send down of the Qur’ān that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
